dedupe_keys.name: hpdmobile residential occupancy and sensor observations

description: The University of Colorado Boulder and Iowa State University publish HPDmobile observations for developing residential occupancy detection. The collection covers six homes, with 15–35 days of measurements per home and at least four concurrent measurement locations. It contains reduced-resolution images, processed audio, indoor environmental readings, occupancy labels and metadata describing completeness and equipment. Images were captured every second and environmental readings every ten seconds. All 58 inspected Figshare components are public and free under CC0. The data can calibrate occupancy and demand-control simulations using model-energyplus. A caveat is that privacy processing changes the original image and audio signals. The collection documents a small household sample, with missing and excluded observations that differ by modality. No media, sensor arrays or raw identifiable material were downloaded.
